coverage.notes: Official first-degree catalogue checked: APSY homepage under Graduação versus Pós-Graduação and https://apsyedu.com.br/graduacao/ (one Psychology bachelor only); https://apsyedu.com.br/graduacao/admissions/ provides the 2027/1 first intake, beginning February 2027. The source-site English localisation alone does not establish English-medium instruction, so the programme must not be advertised as English-taught and scope is not classified none without a direct language statement. The admissions page text was available through an official-site search crawler; direct link opening failed (cache miss), and the official 2027.1 edital, manual and MPT could not be independently inspected. The opened Portuguese programme page was cached earlier than the newer selection page and shows 50 versus the latter’s 75 seats. Domestic-style February start and 29 January 2027 final secondary-credential deadline do not suit students who will take the May 2027 IB examinations.

institution.summary: Psychology-focused higher education provider in Vila Olímpia, São Paulo; first in-person Psychology bachelor’s cohort planned for February 2027.

programmes.name: Psicologia
programmes.campus: Vila Olímpia, São Paulo, SP, Brazil
programmes.about: Five-year, in-person Psychology bachelor’s programme connecting psychological theory, neuroscience, evidence-based clinical approaches and supervised practice from early in the degree.
programmes.overview: Students study psychological theory and neuroscience alongside evidence-based approaches to assessment, psychotherapy and mental-health care. Teaching combines coursework with supervised clinical practice and competency development from the early semesters. APSY describes a teaching clinic and rooms for supervised work at its São Paulo campus. Optional international immersions are advertised, although their destinations and formats may vary.

claims.statement: Artmed School of Psychology (APSY) is a psychology-focused higher-education operation within the Artmed ecosystem; its advertised teaching campus is Rua Alvorada 1151, Vila Olímpia, São Paulo, not Porto Alegre. Its first Psychology undergraduate cohort is scheduled for February 2027.

claims.statement: For the 2027/1 selection process, a full IB Diploma with at least 30 points meets the threshold for the IB external-certificate scoring pathway. This is a floor for using the IB result as selection evidence, not an unconditional overall admission offer; all selection stages and an overall minimum of 50/100 apply. The site does not say whether the stated 30 includes core points.

claims.statement: All school-leaver applicants complete three stages: PREP worth up to 20 points, academic certification and the compulsory written essay worth up to 50, and two interviews worth up to 30. Admission requires participation in all stages and a total of at least 50/100, followed by a merit ranking limited by places.

claims.statement: PREP comprises the application and personal inventory, an official high-school transcript (partial permitted), a teacher/counsellor/director recommendation submitted directly, and an introductory video of up to three minutes. The four complete deliveries are each worth five points; the recommendation and video are not scored for their persuasiveness or production quality.

evidence.locator: Fase 1 – PREP; FAQ – PREP, as quatro entregas
evidence.supports: Identifies four online submissions and completion-based scoring.

claims.statement: The academic component uses either a proctored Primeira Escolha entrance exam (language and mathematics questions) or eligible international/national external certificates, using the highest objective score up to 40 points, plus a mandatory essay of up to 10 points. A certificate-only applicant must still sit the essay.

evidence.locator: Pontuação – Dentro da Certificação Propedêutica: 40 + 10; A prova Primeira Escolha; FAQ – Vou usar só o ENEM/SAT?

claims.statement: Two roughly 25-minute interviews by independent assessors evaluate deliberate questioning, active listening and emotional resilience. They normally occur on campus; video interview requests are accommodated for applicants declaring they cannot attend.
